def: to bubble up or froth (as boiling water), i.e. (figuratively) to be unimportant

occurrences.text: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal–berith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.
Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
